{{Top|leg}}
The '''McPhersons''' were a family of [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmers]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] who supported [[Ariq Joanson]] in his peace plans with the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] and [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]].
